summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of optional-auth (guest browsing), Continue Reading, PWA assets, and legal pages. Backend: 47/48 tests pass (97.9%) — 21/21 new feature tests pass; 26/27 regression tests pass (single pre-known failure: GET /api/ returns 404 due to route ordering bug already reported in iteration_1). Frontend: every requested guest gate, login gate, continue-reading-rail/button, footer, /privacy, /terms, and authenticated /api/reading/* integration was verified end-to-end via Playwright.

minor.issue: Still returns 404 — @api.get('/') is defined AFTER app.include_router(api) in server.py. Pre-existing bug from iteration_1, not regressed.
Occasionally upstream MangaDex/CDN host returns 400/502 (cloud-IP block). Code is correct; this is the documented external CDN limitation.

issues: Cover thumbnail occasionally renders blank/black because its uses the same upstream cover that fails image-proxy for some CDN hosts. Add a fallback poster or lazy-retry. Non-blocking.

action_items: Move @api.get('/') above app.include_router(api) in /app/backend/server.py (low priority cosmetic).
Optional: fallback cover for ContinueReading card when image proxy 400s on a CDN host.
critical_code_review_comments: optional_user dependency correctly returns None instead of raising 401 — clean implementation.
GET /api/episodes/{eid}/pages and /api/titles/{tid}/episodes/{eid} are now public — verified with curl/requests without Authorization header.
POST /api/reading/progress is upsert keyed on (user_id, title_id) — correct dedup. GET /api/reading/continue enriches with title doc and limits to 12. _id correctly projected out.

/api/titles list response shape changed to {items, page, limit, total} since iteration_1 — old test had to be updated. Frontend Home.jsx already adapts to this; just flagging the implicit contract change for future testers.
Manifest, service-worker, and icon assets all served with correct content-types.
Frontend EpisodeView correctly writes localStorage `reading:<title_id>` for guests and additionally POSTs /api/reading/progress when authenticated — verified via network capture.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (updated: adapt to paginated /api/titles response + manga/manhwa-only type)

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested guest + auth + PWA + legal flows

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ep1 episode on the first seeded title via admin login to enable the public episode/page tests. Title row used: first item from GET /api/titles (Boundless Necromancer in current DB).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend list /api/titles returns {items,page,limit,total} not a bare list — handle accordingly. /api/episodes/{eid}/pages and /api/titles/{tid}/episodes/{eid} are public (no auth). /api/reading/* requires auth. Manifest at /manifest.json, service worker at /service-worker.js, icons at /icons/icon-{192,512}.png — all 200. Frontend routes /privacy and /terms have data-testid='privacy-page' & 'terms-page'. Footer is data-testid='site-footer' with children footer-privacy & footer-terms. Login button data-testid='nav-login-btn'. Continue Reading: rail data-testid='continue-reading-rail' on Home, button data-testid='continue-reading-btn' on TitleDetail. LoginGate testids: 'chat-login-gate' (chat/discuss + /lobby), 'reviews-login-gate' (review form).
rca_of_the_issue: n/a — feature set verified working. Sole regression failure (test_root) is pre-existing route-ordering bug already documented in iteration_1.json.
